schema.name: available_announcement_text
schema.sql:
CREATE VIEW available_announcement_text AS
        SELECT art_code,page_number,source_sha256,text,status,'pdf_text_layer' AS method
          FROM announcement_pages WHERE status='extracted_unverified' AND LENGTH(text)>0
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t.art_code,t.page_number,t.source_sha256,t.text,t.status,'local_ocr_unverified' AS method
          FROM announcement_ocr_texts t JOIN announcement_pages p
            ON t.art_code=p.art_code AND t.page_number=p.page_number AND t.source_sha256=p.source_sha256
          WHERE p.status='needs_ocr' AND LENGTH(t.text)>0
            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_ocr_texts n
              WHERE n.art_code=t.art_code AND n.page_number=t.page_number AND n.source_sha256=t.source_sha256
                AND (n.extracted_at>t.extracted_at OR (n.extracted_at=t.extracted_at AND n.run_id>t.run_id)))

schema.name: current_announcement_ir_reconciliation
schema.sql:
CREATE VIEW current_announcement_ir_reconciliation AS
        SELECT * FROM announcement_ir_reconciliation WHERE audit_version=(SELECT value FROM database_settings WHERE key='reconciliation_version')

schema.name: current_announcement_reconciliation
schema.sql:
CREATE VIEW current_announcement_reconciliation AS
        SELECT * FROM announcement_reconciliation WHERE audit_version=(SELECT value FROM database_settings WHERE key='reconciliation_version')

schema.name: current_daily_bars
schema.sql: CREATE VIEW current_daily_bars AS SELECT d.* FROM daily_bars d JOIN latest_successful_snapshots s USING(snapshot_id)

schema.name: current_source_records
schema.sql: CREATE VIEW current_source_records AS SELECT r.* FROM source_records r JOIN latest_successful_snapshots s USING(snapshot_id)

schema.name: latest_available_fund_flow
schema.sql:
CREATE VIEW latest_available_fund_flow AS
        SELECT n.* FROM normalized_fund_flow n JOIN source_snapshots s ON n.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id
        WHERE s.error IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM normalized_fund_flow newer JOIN source_snapshots ns ON newer.snapshot_id=ns.snapshot_id
          WHERE newer.trade_date=n.trade_date AND ns.error IS NULL
            AND (ns.retrieved_at>s.retrieved_at OR (ns.retrieved_at=s.retrieved_at AND newer.snapshot_id>n.snapshot_id)))

schema.name: latest_successful_snapshots
schema.sql: CREATE VIEW latest_successful_snapshots AS SELECT s.* FROM source_snapshots s WHERE error IS NULL AND retrieved_at=(SELECT MAX(t.retrieved_at) FROM source_snapshots t WHERE t.dataset=s.dataset AND t.error IS NULL)

schema.name: reviewed_historical_source_records
schema.sql:
CREATE VIEW reviewed_historical_source_records AS SELECT r.* FROM current_source_records r
        JOIN record_temporal_audit a USING(snapshot_id,row_hash)
        WHERE a.audit_version='supplement-audit-v1' AND a.historical_input_eligible=1
